messages:
sarah.sales: Quick heads up — AstraHealth is asking for a bespoke POC discount. They want 40% off for a 3-month POC + dedicated pool + private deployment. Need deal desk approval ASAP.

mike.dealdesk: Can you drop committed spend numbers and any conversion signal? 40% is high for a POC, we usually max at ~25%. Why 40% here?

sarah.sales: Details from the call:
```
- POC term: 3 months
- Dedicated GPU pool + private (VPC) setup
- Expected consumption: ~1M tokens/day (~$20k/mo at list)
- Dedicated infra baseline: $8,000/mo
- Customer ask: 40% off the committed monthly charge + waive setup fee
- Exec sponsor: Maya (CTO)
- Use case: real-time clinical routing & summarization (HIPAA scope)
```

mike.dealdesk: Ok. Important Qs: is this strategic logo / reference customer? What’s the expected ARR if they convert after the POC? We need CSM signoff and a renewal trigger for any >25% concession.

sarah.sales: They said if POC proves ops cost savings they could convert to a regional rollout — rough post-POC spend could be $50k+/mo. They signed NDA. They also asked explicitly for a % discount vs credits (prefer discount).

ana.legal: @sarah.sales quick legal flags — HIPAA scope + private deployment means we need an SOW + BAA language. We can’t finalize pricing without confirming data handling and a SOC2/BAA path. Also: no open-ended price exceptions without legal + CSM acceptance of renewal clause.

li.engineering: FYI on onboarding: private + dedicated will take ~3-4 weeks for infra + compliance work. Need model size and QPS expectations. If they plan Llama2-70B perf, cost profile changes.

sarah.sales: Initial model will be 13B, likely move to 70B later. Expected peak ~50 qps, baseline ~15 qps. Timeline pressure — they want to start early next month.

mike.dealdesk: Proposal from deal desk: approve up to 30% off for 3 months IF one of the following is accepted by the customer:
- Option A: Customer signs a 6-month follow-on commit at 30% discount (post-POC), OR
- Option B: We provide a $15k credit toward the POC and then 15% ongoing discount on subsequent committed capacity.
Pick one. Also require CSM (josh.se) + legal signoff and SOW.

josh.se: I can commit to running renewal play but need measurable success criteria and exec sponsor confirmation. If they agree to a >=$50k/mo commit after POC, I can push for renewal.

ana.legal: I'll draft a BAA + SOW template with the renewal clause and an explicit data handling appendix. Send me the final price option and I'll attach redlines. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Created deal desk ticket #DD-4127 for this request.

mike.dealdesk: Tentative approval: up to 30% for POC contingent on (1) SOW + BAA signed, (2) explicit renewal trigger (Option A or B chosen), and (3) engineering signoff on timeline. Marking as approved conditionally — ticket #DD-4127. :thumbsup:

sarah.sales: Thanks — I'll push the customer for Option A (30% + 6mo follow-on). Looping in @josh.se and @ana.legal and will update CRM when they confirm.

mike.dealdesk: Please add the final numbers in the ticket once the customer confirms (we need exact committed $/mo to finalize).
